# rubocop

**Tag**: library

## 简介

RuboCop is a Ruby code style checking and code formatting tool.
It aims to enforce the community-driven Ruby Style Guide.

## 官网

- 主页: https://rubocop.org/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/rubocop/rubocop/
- 文档: https://docs.rubocop.org/rubocop/1.91/
- 更新日志: https://github.com/rubocop/rubocop/releases/tag/v1.91.0
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/rubocop/rubocop/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/rubocop
